resources.string: Onion-only profile. There is no saved direct IP and Harw never falls back to a direct connection.
This profile has no Onion address. Harw will not connect until you import an Onion address or explicitly allow Direct IP for this profile.
Onion only. Harw will not use the saved direct IP, even if Tor cannot connect.
Direct IP only. Traffic goes to this profile’s saved IP without Tor.
Harw tries Onion first and can use the saved direct IP if Tor fails. This applies only to this exact profile.
Connect to %1$s directly over its saved IP, without Tor. The server and the network path may see your IP. This choice is saved only for this exact profile.
Try Onion for %1$s first. If it fails, Harw may connect directly using the saved IP. That can reveal your IP to the server and network path. This choice is saved only for this exact profile.
The saved profile changed. Review the new profile before choosing a route.
